name: Henshin Heroine no Himitsu o Shitte Shimatta no de
original_name: 変身ヒロインの秘密を知ってしまったので
source:
I just by chance saw that a girl transformed and fought with a creature.
Her name is M*w Lettuce. I blackmail her taking advantage of her secret.

"If you wanted me not to leak out your secret...... Could you please be obedient to me?"

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ214776.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
